prompt:
Substantial craftsmanship cleanup REPAINT of this exact illustration, maintaining the hand-painted anime art direction and same approximately 13:10 framing. Preserve the woman's identity and face, silver high ponytail/blue bow/black rose, cyan eyes, low round sunglasses and little fang smile; preserve her blue collared rolled-sleeve shirt, black shorts and boots, same seated pose, two legs and body proportions, motorcycle silhouette, camera/crop, cherry trees, park and bright spring daylight. Do NOT change the scene or costume.

The user rejects obvious AI artifacts: excessive implausible micro-detail, twisted color patches and mechanically repeated texture. Reconstruct forms intentionally and simplify substantially, not blur/filter the existing image. Every retained mark must describe a real form, light or material. Calm connected shapes and controlled edges with selective focal detail.

CLOTH: Replace the dense crushed triangular blue facets with believable broad fabric surfaces. The oversized shirt has room and weight: long gravity folds below shoulders, a few tension folds at elbow and waist, a clean rolled cuff with definite thickness. Keep strong connected cobalt midtones and grouped shadow planes; do not fill every square centimeter with zigzags. Black shorts are simple matte fabric with clear hems and a few practical creases. No fake pockets, buckles or stitched lines appearing/disappearing.

MOTORCYCLE: Rebuild the engine/frame, controls, springs and wheels with coherent geometry from the same perspective. One clear tank surface with one broad soft blue sky reflection and one limited foliage reflection, remove camouflage mosaic patches and bright random nicks. Clean circular headlight and mirror with plausible reflection. Engine is a legible V-twin grouped into two simple finned cylinders and one crankcase, use only a few consistent fin lines; remove nonsense tiny pipes, melted bolts, repeated squiggles and letterlike markings. Continuous handlebar and connected brake lever. Two meaningful rear shocks, simple regular spring spacing, circular wheel rim and axle; reduce redundant rear hub details. Dark rubber is quiet with sparse tread hints. Keep physical overlap behind her legs and her weight resting naturally on the seat. Reflections have a shared light source, no random glitter. Metal stays PAINTED with broad designed highlights, not photorealistic pasted micro-detail.

HAIR: simplify excessive fine strands and jagged surface facets into a small hierarchy of smooth flowing broad and narrow ribbon locks with clean silver midtone interiors. Long connected cool-gray shadow shapes and broad curved light bands, tapering ends, selected fine strands only at silhouette and face. Preserve fullness and length without wiry spaghetti or sharp little white scratches.
FACE/SKIN: retain character and confident expression, clean aligned eyes above ordinary round sunglasses. Intact calm warm skin fields, one coherent daylight/shadow grouping; remove random angular white triangles on legs, patchy camouflage, shiny plastic hotspots and unnecessary facial ticks. Natural knee and thigh volume.
BACKGROUND: cherry blossoms read as painted grouped branch/canopy masses with a few individually shaped flowers only near focal foreground; avoid thousands of cloned star shapes. Trees have a clear trunk/branch structure and large coherent foliage groups, fewer repeated leaf speckles. Simple quiet modern buildings, continuous curb and walkway perspective, sparse deliberate fallen petals. Dappled light in a few believable soft-edged groups, not confetti covering every object.

STYLE: deliberate hand-painted Japanese anime, opaque layered color masses, hard and soft edge hierarchy, a little directional overpainting, selective varying contour lines. Keep painterly character and rich spring colors, do not turn into flat vector, minimalist poster, smudged oil painting, watercolor, generic polished cel shading or blurry airbrush. Resolve face, hand/arm contacts and principal mechanical shapes; secondary areas remain economical. No added props, text, symbols, watermark or UI.
observations: Original identity, pose and composition retained. Shirt planes, engine groupings and rear wheel hardware are cleaner; skin and hair retain some existing small highlights. This is a visual cleanup candidate, not a claim that every artifact is removed.
verification: Artwork viewed only; no tests/browser/build/runtime replacement.
